# Fresh Threads Laundromat

> Self-service laundromat at 223 S Pete Ellis Dr, Bloomington, Indiana. A clean, colorful self-serve laundromat on S Pete Ellis Dr with big washers, a wall of Speed Queen dryers, card and QR-code pay, and an attendant who goes out of her way to help.

- Phone: (812) 322-1023
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Unionville, Ellettsville, Smithville, Nashville
- Google rating: 4.1 from 130 reviews

## Services
- Big washers: Front-load and top-load washers for everyday loads, towels and bulky bedding.
- Speed Queen dryers: A long wall of stacked Speed Queen dryers, so you are rarely waiting for one.
- Card, QR or quarters: Pay with a credit or debit card, scan a QR code with your phone, or grab quarters at the change machine.
- Folding tables & carts: Mid-century folding tables in tomato red and sage green, plus rolling carts and hanging racks.
- Friendly attendant: An attendant on the floor most days to help with machines, change and first-time questions.
- A comfy wait: Retro molded chairs by the windows, a TV, a Coke machine and a clean restroom.

## About
Fresh Threads Laundromat is in the strip of shops at 223 S Pete Ellis Dr, Suite 6, on Bloomington's east side, under the green metal roof. You may know it by its old name on Google, Bloomington Quick Clean Laundry. Inside it is a classic Bloomington laundromat: cream tile floors, front-load and top-load washers, a long wall of Speed Queen dryers, tomato-red and sage-green folding tables and a row of mustard, rust, mint and green molded chairs by the windows. Reviewers keep coming back to the same things: it is clean, it is well kept, and there is a friendly attendant on the floor who will help you figure out the machines, get change, or just point you in the right direction when you are new in town.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Fresh Threads is open every day from 6 AM to 11 PM. Start your last wash by 10 PM so it has time to finish.
- Q: Is there an attendant?
  A: Yes, most of the day. An attendant is on site Monday to Friday 10 AM to 2 PM and 3 PM to 6 PM, and Saturday and Sunday 10 AM to 6 PM.
- Q: Can I pay with a card or my phone?
  A: Yes. You can pay with a credit or debit card or by scanning a QR code with your phone. There is also a change machine for quarters.
- Q: Is this the same place as Bloomington Quick Clean Laundry?
  A: Yes. Same address, 223 S Pete Ellis Dr, Suite 6, now under the Fresh Threads Laundromat sign.
- Q: Can I wash comforters and big loads?
  A: Yes. The large front-load washers and big Speed Queen dryers handle comforters, bedding and big piles of towels.
- Q: Is there somewhere to wait?
  A: Plenty of seats by the front windows, a TV, a Coke machine and a restroom.
